newsitem.title: UK: Copper's roller-coaster ride continues in evening.
newsitem.headline: Copper's roller-coaster ride continues in evening.

text.p: Copper prices on the London Metal Exchange (LME) continued their recent fluctuating trend during Thursday evening inter-office trade.
Traders said the break below $1,900 at the afternoon close triggered off mixed selling and liquidation orders in anticipation of further losses on Friday.

But after trading down to the low $1,880s a sudden trend reversal triggered shortcovering which saw three months delivery quoted at $1,892/$1,896 a tonne at 1800 GMT. This was virtually unchanged from the afternoon close but still $22 below Wednesday's close.
Other metals showed little movement during the evening.
